11/S0.subgoal: Explain the factors related to VR content that contribute to the onset and severity of cyber sickness.

11/S1.subgoal: Describe the different types of inputs, including questionnaire-based, physiological, behavioral, and content-based, used to measure cyber sickness.

11/S2.subgoal: Describe the manual and automated methods, specifically using transparent models, for evaluating cyber sickness.
